vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Company makes the road shorter.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek telling A person, maybe 40s, with a missing fingertip about themself. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." Better close to the fire today.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
You catch fragments by the fire — Kwame telling A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
📋 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Kwame, Ella, Huia, Nikolai and Tashi met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Kwame, Ella, Huia, Nikolai, Tashi are hurt.
🛡️ Dominic, Kwame, Ella, Raimund and Huia met them at the door — 5 put down. Dominic, Kwame, Ella, Raimund, Huia are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Dominic, Kwame, Ella, Raimund and Huia met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Dominic, Kwame, Ella, Raimund, Huia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tashi just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ella just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Raimund just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Huia just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Dominic, Kwame, Ella, Raimund and Huia met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Dominic, Kwame, Ella, Huia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wei just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Vy met them at the door — 1 put down. Vy is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
